title: Tinderwick - Lantern Lullaby (r2 remaster pilot)
_note: R2 REMASTER PILOT (parallel to tinderwick-a; NOT wired into the game). Panel brief: docs/reviews/music-remaster-panel.md. Home-town theme, the first full statement of the LANTERN CALL leitmotif (the Vesper contour given a fixed rhythm: sol-do-re lift on a dotted 'q. e h', mi-re-do settle). 96 BPM, 4/4, C major with borrowed-iv (Fm6) melancholy. Form A(8) B(8) A'(8) = 24 bars, ~60 s. A: bare and tender - lead, guide-tone strings, a music-box harp roll, the bass breathing in half notes, a fireside clock-tick. B: the bridge turns to the IV (Fmaj7-Em7-Dm7-G7), the lead CALLS and the flute ANSWERS, the bass starts to walk (chromatic approach notes), swung harp rolls, and the phrase climbs to the Ab5 borrowed-iv peak. A': the tune comes home fuller - walking bass, a flute guide-tone counter-line under the lead, a soft rim backbeat. The ECHO track is a composed stand-in for the SNES echo buffer (the lead, a dotted eighth late and ~55% velocity, wrapped round the loop seam). Bell glints quote the Lantern Call lift at the A-phrase ends. <=8 voices. Original melody throughout (VISION.md).

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: The Lantern Call: G4 C5 D5 (lift) / E5 D5 C5 (settle). A 4+4 antecedent/consequent; the consequent reaches G5 (the one leap) and sighs through A-Ab over F-Fm6. B: call-and-response with the flute, rising to Ab5.

tracks.name: echo
tracks._note: Composed SNES-echo: the lead a dotted eighth late, softer, wrapped across the loop seam.

tracks.name: flute
tracks._note: B: answers the lead's calls (bars 11-12) and harmonises the climb (15-16). A': a slow guide-tone counter-line below the lead (E-D-E / A-G-F-G / F / E-G-A-C / F / E-D), moving against the tune.

tracks.name: pad
tracks._note: Two-note guide-tone voicings (3rds/7ths), voice-led; swells into the B climax.

tracks.name: harp
tracks._note: A: delicate 3-note music-box rolls with a breath. B/A': a full swung (triplet long-short) open-voiced harp roll up and back down - not a block 1-3-5-3 arpeggio.

tracks.name: bass
tracks._note: A: half-note hearth pulse with stepwise pickups. B: walking quarters with chromatic approach tones. A': walking, last bar G7/B leading tone back into the loop.

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: Dynamics by entry: A = a clock-tick on 2 & 4; B = soft swung kick/hat; A' = rim backbeat. Tom triplet into A', snare pickup into the loop seam.
